summary: Second re-review of 008: Finish pre-write checks require active again so a mid-abort Cancel cannot resume into add/amend. Cancel in starting waits with take || throwAbort. A cancelled start aborts only the rebase it started; rebase mode is refused while anything is in progress. Cancel is gated off during finishing. Tests first; earlier Phase 13 guards stay. Docs and the rest of the suite are skipped.

steps.title: T11, T12, and a foreign rebase must stay
steps.rationale: The three failures this pass answers — read them before the predicates
steps.notes: T11 starts Cancel without awaiting, then resolves the pick: no add -u / amend. T12 parks guideSource.build, awaits Cancel, and requires --abort already logged. The foreign-rebase row refuses Start and never --aborts. The whole driver file is new, so this one range is the three rows.

steps.title: Pre-write stillOpen is only active
steps.rationale: The contract T11 needs — finishing here was the door Cancel walked through
steps.notes: teardownSession claims finishing synchronously before --abort returns. A widened active||finishing made a mid-abort Cancel look like Finish's own writes. Callers pass active before pauseOwnership and finishing after.

steps.title: Five pre-write checks, then finishing
steps.rationale: First consumer — active through the pick, finishing only once writes start

steps.title: take waits only if the mapper throws
steps.rationale: The T12 wait — a falsy mapper return is a result in 1001.3.0
steps.notes: value === attempt is false on the first sync eval, so take used to return false and Cancel resolved while rebase-merge still existed. throwAbort keeps waiting until startSettled(attempt).

steps.title: Abort a cancelled start only on exit 0
steps.rationale: Defense behind refuse — a failed rebase -i must not --abort someone else's sequencer
steps.notes: Ownership is set only when git exited 0. The old readGitState().rebase !== null test aborted a rebase that was already there.

steps.title: Refuse rebase while anything is in progress
steps.rationale: The D5 cut Start and the preview both call — do not let git refuse after the fact
steps.notes: rebase or merge / cherry-pick / revert / bisect. Hint: Finish or abort the rebase in progress first. This file is new; the range is the new first check.
